title: Hugo Souza in the Brazilian National Team
seoTitle: Hugo Souza in Brazil Squad: Ancelotti tests goalkeepers
subtitle: The Goalkeeper's Choice Amidst Criticism and Tests
excerpt: Coach Carlo Ancelotti is testing new options for the Brazilian National Team's goal, with Hugo Souza, Otávio, and Pedro Morisco competing for the spot.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Carlo Ancelotti is testing new options for the Brazilian National Team's goal, with Hugo Souza, Otávio, and Pedro Morisco vying for the spot. The decision comes after a controversial performance against Australia and pressure for greater defensive security.

Hugo Souza in the Brazilian National Team

Hugo Souza, who started in the first friendly against Australia, was criticized for not jumping to try and save the free-kick taken by Irankunda. The trend suggests Otávio will be the starter, as the goalkeeper gained ground at Cruzeiro after Cássio's serious injury and is ahead of Pedro Morisco in the race for the starting position.

Carlo Ancelotti and the Goalkeeper Rotation

Ancelotti's track record shows that the coach usually rotates goalkeepers during FIFA international windows with friendlies. Ancelotti's first friendlies were against Asian teams, South Korea and Japan. In the first match, Bento started. In the second, Hugo Souza was among the starting eleven. Later, against African teams, Ancelotti fielded Ederson against Senegal and Bento against Tunisia. In the more challenging clashes against France and Croatia, the Italian also rotated goalkeepers: Ederson started against the French, while Bento started against the Croatians.

The Debate Over Goalkeeping Experience

The goalkeeper position in the national team has once again become the center of attention. Hugo Souza's insecure performance drew criticism from fans and the press, raising a red flag for the coaching staff. In response, Ancelotti is already rehearsing changes to the starting lineup, testing Otávio in goal instead of the Corinthians goalkeeper, in an attempt to redefine the team's defensive security.

Veterans and Youngsters in Contention

The selection of names to wear the number 1 jersey continues to be a point of controversy among specialists and fans. The absence of Grêmio's number 1, Weverton, raised questions about the criteria for opportunity adopted for the national team. Another name that inevitably enters the discussions is that of veteran Fábio, from Fluminense, who continues to accumulate miraculous saves and demonstrate an enviable level of consistency.

The Next Decisive Test

The upcoming fixtures will be decisive in determining whether Ancelotti's test will bring the necessary stability or if the demand for names like Weverton and experienced Serie A players will become inevitable. The pressure on the Brazilian goal promises to remain high if the on-field response is not immediate.

With information from CNN Brasil, R7 Esportes.
